integrity: Analytic combinatorial proof with standalone finite reconstruction and file-level integrity hashes.
scientific_limitations: Applies to standard iterated bipyramids over origin-containing strictly convex n-gons, n>=5; vertex-containing hyperplanes and nonstandard realizations excluded. Historical priority may be incomplete; finite checker supports but does not replace the arbitrary-n proof.
title: Constant face vectors with arbitrarily many section types in four-dimensional double bipyramids
